subject: Quick check before noon
text:
Hi,
Quick reminder about the community kitchen invoice and the cooler return, because things got messy again and I don't want the date to slide. I know you mentioned sending it by the 14th, and our board needs it before the check run, so could you confirm today if anything is still missing? The complication is that our usual van was pulled at the last minute for an emergency transport, so two volunteers are trying to split the cooler between cars. That means the return might be an hour late, and I need your staff to know before noon or they'll lock the loading bay. If that happens, I can meet someone outside, but please tell me whether that works. I also wanted to mention the donation receipt for the catering service; it was filed under the wrong event folder on the shared drive, but I'm certain it's the September soup night, not the fall festival. I'm sorry to keep stacking small tasks into one message. I'm rushed because the phone is dying, the printer jammed, and I have to get back to a group of kids making sandwiches. The kids already used the wrong stickers, so the labels need reprinting after the delivery too. If you need corrected paperwork, I can email a clean version in twenty minutes. Otherwise just reply with a yes on the cooler and the invoice, and I'll stop bothering you. Thanks for being patient when every day feels like a shuffle.
